Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: one high-fidelity Japanese desktop web application screen for RocketWright. Wide landscape 16:9, crisp typography and production-minded information hierarchy. Use the attached RocketWright analysis screenshot as reference for product identity, neutral charcoal surfaces, tiny gray-overall workers with ochre helmets, transparent PET water rocket with blue nose and fins, restrained hangar lighting. Evolve the layout; preserve the black engineering-workshop character. Edge-to-edge app screen, no device/browser/macOS traffic-light chrome, no marketing cards, no decorative neon HUD or circular gauges. Top identity bar 48px: RW, RocketWright, 'water-rocket', '案A · v12', save state, gear '設定', subtle top-right 'UIドラフト / 表示例'. Under it a stable 48px labeled phase strip: '条件', '設計', '解析', '比較', '組立', '出力'. Selected phase uses blue underline plus text/shape, not color alone. Left dock approx 200px for relevant objects/steps, central working view uses remaining flexible width, right decision panel approx 340px. Thin 1px separators, 4-6px corner radius controls, 8px spacing rhythm, white primary text, muted gray secondary text, normal Japanese sans serif with clear readable body labels. One blue primary call to action per screen; amber for pending verification, teal confined mostly to scientific visualization; no large bright green promotional button. Object versions and scope are visible. Bottom status strip contains current work, elapsed time, pending/final state and the next action. All metrics and geometry are illustrative UI content, not physical verification.
Screen: analysis with readable interpretation and pinned snapshots. Select '解析' in phase strip. Left dock header '解析の工程', checked '条件の確認', selected '流体解析', queued '飛行と回収', queued '候補の比較', lower target '機体全体・フィン'. Center: large physical rear monitor attached to matte metal truss shows dominant ice-teal turbulent wake around a horizontal rocket, a velocity cross-section heatmap below with clear units/legend, and a residual chart whose traces end at iteration 240 while x-axis ends at600. Label monitor '流体解析 / 正面風', small badge '計算途中'. Foreground horizontal PET rocket on cradle with two SMALL workers and a tool trolley; keep foreground about 18% central height so graphics dominate. Above view compact segmented controls '工房' selected and '図を拡大', plus '整備員を表示' toggle.
Right panel is now useful explanatory content, tabs '解説' selected, '履歴', '相談'. Header 'フィン周りの流れを確認中'. Three short sections with large readable Japanese: '何を確かめる？' body '空気の流れが機体に与える影響を調べます。'; '今わかること' body '速度断面と後流の途中結果が届いています。'; 'まだ決められないこと' body '計算が終わるまで性能の比較は保留します。'. Below fine divider '図の見方' and concise '青い部分ほど流れ方向の速度が低い領域です。', small text link '凡例と条件を見る'. Do not invent a definitive aerodynamic conclusion from the illustration.
Below center a horizontal three-result snapshot ribbon, middle selected. Put a pin icon and label '02:06 の結果を固定中', and separate blue button '最新へ戻る' plus small '新着 1件'. Distinguish the running job time from the pinned artifact time. The main monitor's selected artifact can show 02:06, current job elapsed02:18. Bottom stage status '流体解析を実行中' / '経過 02:18' / 'この工程の残り 見積もり中'. Secondary outline actions '動きを止める' and '解析を中断'. No overall progress percentage. Keep enough empty space and clear groups, avoid dense walls of tiny text. This is the revised, calmer real product UI, not a poster.
images.review: Explained purpose/current results/pending judgement; pinned history separate from running job; residual traces stop at current iteration.

Screen: comparison and a visible unapplied edit proposal. Select '比較' in phase strip. Left dock '候補案' with '案A 回収を優先' selected and '案B 費用を優先'; object tree 'ノーズ', 'ボトル', 'フィン' selected, '回収装置'. Center top shows two small side-by-side grounded blue-nosed transparent PET rockets, same camera and scale, labeled '案A · v12' and '案B · v08'. One tiny worker stands beside selected fin only; keep the diagram and selection usable. Show outline/pale-blue translucent overlay on the selected fin labeled '変更案'; no claim physically feasible.
Below center is a very clean comparative table with columns '比較項目', '案A', '案B'; rows '到達高度' -> '29.6 m', '30.8 m'; '概算費用' -> '2,300 円', '1,900 円'; '組立の確認' -> '未確認', '未確認'; '実機の試験' -> '未実施', '未実施'. A small caption '同じ条件の表示例'. Do not show a fabricated success rate or validation badges. Make row selection and target/units legible.
Right panel tabs '変更' selected, '根拠', '相談'. Header 'フィンの変更案', version text 'v12 → v13 下書き'. Readable labeled form rows '材料' value '未選択', '寸法' button '寸法を編集'. Section '影響するもの' lists '流体解析', '飛行結果', '部品図・組立手順'. Amber compact notice '変更後の性能は未評価です。'. Brief text '保存すると新しい案を作ります。'. One blue primary action '変更案を保存'. Below secondary '変更を破棄'. Do not present save as launching reanalysis, approving fabrication, or silently updating selected design.
Bottom status is '案A · v12 を表示中' and '変更はまだ適用されていません'. A separate modest '採用の確認へ' button is disabled with helper '変更の扱いを決めてください'. No oversized glowy CTA, no modal covering data. This is a clear engineering edit-preview screen with comparison still visible.
images.refinement_prompt: Edit this RocketWright comparison UI screenshot with only these two small copy corrections. Preserve everything else, including the rockets, selected fin overlay, layout, phase strip, all right-side controls and metrics. First, in the bottom status strip replace '経過 02:18' with '未保存の変更あり'; this comparison/editing mode is not timing a running simulation. Second, label the existing comparison table as referring to UNCHANGED design versions: change the column heading '案A' to '案A · v12', change '案B' to '案B · v08', and change the small upper-right caption '同じ条件の表示例' to '変更前の結果 / 表示例'. The modified fin is an unapplied draft and must not seem to have those computed performance results. Keep all other text and visual details unchanged.
images.review: Existing results reference unchanged versions; unsaved change remains a draft; no simulation timer in comparison mode.

Screen: detailed assembly planning with hand-and-tool access review, not a fabricated completed manual. Select '組立' in phase strip. Left dock header '組立の工程', list '01 部品をそろえる', '02 フィンを取り付ける' selected, '03 回収装置を取り付ける', '04 全体を点検する'. Compact progress '手順 2 / 4' is navigation only, NOT completed steps. Do not show prior steps as performed automatically.
Center is a large high-quality 3D assembly diagram of a transparent PET bottle held horizontally in a practical cradle, blue fin assembly hovering slightly apart in an exploded view. A translucent human-scale hand outline and a tool envelope approach the outer fin mount, with separate approach and withdrawal path arrows. Keep hand size physically comparable to bottle, not mascot size. Amber highlight at one access-constrained region, leader line '工具の抜き取りを確認'. One SMALL ochre-helmet worker stands in a lower corner pointing, clearly an annotation character. No unsafe fabrication details, pressure setting, torque value or guessed clearance number. Include central view tabs '組立図' selected, '手と工具', '写真'. Camera controls '回転', '断面', '拡大'.
Right panel header '02 フィンを取り付ける'. Selectors '作業者' value '成人', '手袋' value '未設定', '工具' value '未選択'. Section 'この工程で使うもの' lists 'フィン部品', '保持具', with small parts icons. Section '作業の確認' checklist style rows '向きと位置', '手が入る経路', '工具を抜く経路', all pending rings. Amber message '条件が不足しているため判定保留'. Small secondary action '作業条件を設定'. One blue primary action '確認項目を記録'. It records selected observations, not automatic completion or a geometry safety pass. Bottom left '前の工程', bottom right secondary '次の工程'. Clear text '手順の閲覧と実作業の記録は別に保存'. No green checkmarks implying physical verification.
Mood: black engineering studio with readable technical assembly illustration, understated warm work light. Generous figure space, calm professional panels, cute crew only small accents. The PET bottle pressure boundary stays intact; show external fin mount only, never drilling or cutting the pressure vessel. All shapes are conceptual UI illustrations.
images.refinement_prompt: Edit this assembly UI mockup, preserving the app shell, all phase navigation, right-side forms and checklist, workers, blue fins, PET bottle, lighting and overall composition. Correct ONLY the central tool/access illustration and the bottom elapsed-time field. The screwdriver MUST point to a screw on the EXTERNAL METAL FIN-MOUNT BRACKET above the bottle, near the separated blue fin. Move the translucent hand and screwdriver upward to that bracket. The driver tip and its axis must be visibly outside the bottle silhouette. Both the approach and withdrawal path arrows must route around the external bracket, with the amber highlight and '工具の抜き取りを確認' leader pointing to this external access area. The rear circular PET bottle wall must be completely intact and transparent, no hole, no fastener, no tool touching it, no orange end-cap. This is an external clamp attachment only; never drilling or penetrating the pressure-retaining bottle. Keep all scientific/assembly content clearly a conceptual UI illustration, not a validated procedure. In the bottom status strip, replace '経過 02:18' with '作業記録 未開始', leaving the other status labels unchanged. Make no other edits.
images.review: Tool moved to external fin-mount bracket; pressure-retaining bottle stays intact. Conceptual illustration only; not an approved clamp or fastening design.
